name: QUEUE-OWED-pump-builds-the-head
old: if (building || !state.owes(queue)) return;   // QUEUE-OWED: a pixel the stream let go while it waited is never built
note: The pump starts on the queue's head whatever the stream holds: a pixel let go by the frame's crossing before the pump's turn is built whole and thrown away, while the grid round the traveller waits - the report.

name: QUEUE-OWED-books-unread
note: owes() drops nothing: every queued pixel is built, let go or not (the pump as it was).

name: QUEUE-OWED-the-whole-queue-dropped
note: A let-go head takes the owed pixels behind it with it: the grid's new edge is never built.

name: QUEUE-OWED-one-let-go-dropped-a-turn
note: One let-go pixel dropped a call: a second one behind it answers owed and is built.
